issues.summary: The hook fires once only ONE of the next_functions is set up, not all of them, so the Node isn't ready to inspect yet; either document that the Node is not ready for inspection or trigger the hook only once it is fully ready.
The hook should propagate to any worker thread from any system, not only some threads.
The docstring example uses private APIs; it should be rewritten with public APIs.
The hook goes through the engine instead of being called directly; it should follow the same pattern as saved_variable_hooks.
The trigger here looks redundant because set_next_edges above should already fire the hook, which could make it fire twice.
The test should also check that nodes[1] is correct, using a multi-output differentiable function such as split().
